about: Per-repository settings for reach-census.mjs. extraCandidates adds files that are checks but do not carry a test-file name (exclude removes named files from that glob, with the reason); localNode is the Node major the maintainers run package scripts and documented commands under (CI steps use their own setup-node version).

exclude.why: its header (tests/harness/server.mjs:1-2) says it is the local static server the harness scripts load the app from, not a check
